text:
sam (partnerships): heads up — acme reported failures from customers running our marketplace image with CUDA 12.2 RC and nvidia driver 555.x. reports look like quant-kernel mismatches leading to wrong logits / occasional OOMs. tagging @maria @gwen @josh. jira INF-4321 for triage. :eyes:

maria (eng-runtime): thanks. can you drop one log example and the marketplace image id? any crash stack or just bad outputs?

josh (acme-partner): thanks — attaching quick snippet we captured from a customer VM: 
```
E inference.cpp:451] kv_cache_mismatch: expected 1048576 got 786432
W model_runner.cpp:120] soft-fail: token_probs out of range for some batches
```
image: gs://acme-marketplace/redwood-inference/v1.3.2-cuda12.2-rc
customers seeing weird tokens + perf regressions on long-context gen (>2k). we can repro on our infra with nv 555.38 and cudnn 9.3.0.

sam (partnerships): ok — sounds like quant kernel change in CUDA12.2 RC is the culprit. proposal: recommend partners pin marketplace images to CUDA 12.1 / driver 535.x for now, and we produce a hotfix runtime build that avoids the new kernel path. @maria can you confirm feasibility and ETA?

maria (eng-runtime): feasible. i can cut a build that forces the older kernel code path / disables the new quant optimization. quick patch + CI should be ready in ~8h if nothing else blocks. testing plan: canary with internal workload then partner canary. will need a pinned driver list from partnerships + ops for rollout gating.

gwen (product): we also need comms. partners and end-customers should get a joint advisory. timeline: hotfix canary by end of day -> partner canary tomorrow morning -> public advisory after canary success. @josh can you hold marketplace listing changes until we align on messaging?

ops-oncall: for rollout gating: canary strategy we recommend — 5% traffic for 1 hour, check perf + correctness, 20% for 2 hours, then full. rollback hooks: auto-fallback to previous runtime image and driver pin. i'll prepare runbook entries (will link here). :thumbsup:

josh (acme-partner): will hold. we can schedule partner canary 09:00 UTC tomorrow. i copied marketplace engineering on the thread. we'll also block marketplace auto-updates for the image tag.

maria (eng-runtime): quick note with pin snippet for partners to avoid the kernel path while we ship hotfix: 
```
# marketplace manifest override (example)
ENV CUDA_VERSION=12.1
ENV NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION=535.104
RUN sed -i 's/CUDA=12.2/CUDA=12.1/' /etc/marketplace-runtime.conf
```
this will be in the advisory.

sam (partnerships): cicd-bot — can you create INF-4321-hotfix branch + create release candidate tag once build passes?

cicd-bot: created branch "INF-4321-hotfix" and scheduled nightly build. 1 job queued. (<https://ci.internal/redwood/INF-4321/>) :robot_face:

gwen (product): i'll draft the joint advisory and share in #marketing for approval. want to time the advisory with partner canary success to avoid false alarms.

josh (acme-partner): thanks all — we'll pause marketplace pushes and run the partner canary at 09:00 UTC. once you give canary green i can flip the image tag and send customer notice with your advisory. :+1:

sam (partnerships): perfect. i'll coordinate press/marketplace cadence and follow up with a short customer advisory draft in ~3h. tagging this thread as the canonical coordination channel. :wave:
